feature_name: Automatic deployment of open models to Vertex AI endpoints
summary: BigQuery ML can automatically deploy open models to Vertex AI endpoints with managed lifecycle and reservation support.
extended_definition: BigQuery ML can automatically deploy open models to Vertex AI endpoints with managed lifecycle and reservation support.

supporting_pages.title: "Generate text embeddings by using an open model and the AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING\
evidence_snippets: Set service account permissions: resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy and resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy Deploy and undeploy a Vertex AI model: aiplatform.endpoints.deploy aiplatform.endpoints.undeploy Create a model and run inference: bigquery.jobs.create bigquery.models.create bigquery.models.getData bigquery.models.updateData bigquery.models.updateMetadata You might also be able to get these permissions with custom roles or other predefined roles .

Alternatively, you can immediately undeploy the model by using the ALTER MODEL statement , as shown in the following example: ALTER MODEL bqml tutorial . qwen3 embedding model SET OPTIONS ( deploy model = false ); For more information, see Automatic or immediate open model undeployment .
Open models that you deploy to Vertex AI are charged per machine-hour.
